blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.
blocks.zh: 休眠-状态fMRI(rs-fMRI)是诊断脑病和发现病理机制的重要非侵入性工具. 然而,现有的图表对比性学习方法往往未充分利用各个培训时期的增强历史以及不同观点之间的关系。 在本文中,我们引入了由地理学指导的多视图图对比性学习框架,并配有动态地理学地理学增强(MCDA)用于fMRI分析. 与使用固定噪声或边缘投放的传统GCL不同,MCDA采用了动态增强更新(DAU)模块来迭代地完善被增强的地貌. 具体地说,我们纳入了自我意识和跨样本增强战略,以同时捕捉个人特定的功能特征和主体间异质性. 然后,我们设计了一个地形学指导的多视图图对比性学习计划,它不仅探讨原始网络与其扩大观点之间的相互关系,而且探讨不同扩大观点之间的相互关系,以最大限度地实现结构信息保存。 我们描述分数级优化方向,为对比目标确定下限. 该框架结合了脑障碍诊断的分类和对比性损失,并研究了作为潜在生物标志的歧视性功能连接模式. 对包含1,236个学科的两个公共rs-fMRI数据集进行的实验表明,MCDA的性能超过了最先进的方法. 该代码已在\url{https://github.com/goodcodinga goodboy/MCDA}公开发布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) is a powerful non-invasive tool for uncovering the pathological mechanisms of brain disorders [ 1 , 2 ] .
Rs-fMRI data can be modeled as non-Euclidean graphs that capture functional connectivity patterns and interactions between brain regions of interests (ROIs), facilitating automated diagnosis of brain disorders like major depressive disorder (MDD) and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
休眠状态功能核磁共振(rs-fMRI)是发现大脑紊乱的病理机制[1,2]的强大非侵入性工具.
Rs-fMRI数据可以被建模为非欧克利得图,能够捕捉功能连接模式和有兴趣的大脑区域(ROIs)之间的相互作用,为主要抑郁障碍(MDD)和自闭症频谱障碍(ASD)等脑病的自动诊断提供方便[3].

blocks.en:
Various graph-based learning methods have been developed to extract discriminative representations from fMRI data, such as BrainGNN [ 4 ] and graph transformer-based foundation model [ 5 ] .
Li et al. [ 4 ] proposed a clustering-based embedding method in the graph convolutional layer and provided users the flexibility to interpret different levels of biomarkers through graph node pooling and several innovative loss terms to regulate the pooling operations.
Instead of treating brain networks as graphs for processing, some studies also convert rs-fMRI from graph structures into low-dimensional vectors for embedded learning.
Wang et al. [ 5 ] proposed a graph transformer-based foundation model for brain functional connectivity networks (FCN) that integrates node and edge embeddings to extract versatile features.
blocks.zh:
已经开发出各种以图表为基础的学习方法,从fMRI数据中提取出歧视性的表示,如BrainGNN [4]和以图表变压器为基础的基础模型 [5].
李等编. [4]在图分层中提出了基于集群的嵌入方法,并为用户提供了通过图分节点集和几个创新的损失术语来规范集合操作来解释不同层次的生物标志的灵活性.
一些研究不把脑网络作为处理的图表处理,而是将rs-fMRI从图表结构转换为低维向量用于嵌入式学习.
王等编. [5]提出了以图表变压器为基础的脑功能连通网络(FCN)基础模型,将节点和边缘嵌入集成以提取多功能特征.

blocks.en:
Graph contrastive learning (GCL) has been investigated for fMRI representation learning and brain disorder analysis [ 6 , 7 ] .
By treating each brain network as a graph structure, GCL typically generates different augmented views of a brain network and then optimizes feature space via a contrastive loss, thereby boosting robustness and accuracy in downstream tasks.
Beyond generating augmented views at the current training step, we investigate how their evolution across epochs can support history-guided augmentation refinement.
Furthermore, different augmented views are expected to express distinct functional connectivities from brain networks, enabling a comprehensive representation of topological structures.
Nevertheless, most existing GCL methods [ 6 , 8 , 9 ] fail to model the interrelationships among augmented views and tend to overlook feature expression between augmented networks.
Those limitations often affect discriminative power of graph representation,
ultimately affecting the accuracy and robustness of task-specific predictions.
blocks.zh:
对FMRI代表式学习和脑功能障碍分析的图表对比性学习(GCL)进行了调查[6,7].
通过将每个脑网作为图表结构对待,GCL通常会产生对大脑网络的不同增强视图,然后通过对比性损失来优化特征空间,从而提升下游任务的稳健性和准确性.
除了在当前培训阶段产生更多意见外,我们还调查了它们跨越各个时代的演变如何能支持以历史指导为基础的强化改进。
此外,预计不同的扩大观点将表达与大脑网络不同的功能连接,从而能够全面体现地形结构。
然而,大多数现有的GCL方法[6、8、9]未能模拟扩大的意见之间的相互关系,往往忽略扩大的网络之间的特征表达。
这些限制往往影响到图示的歧视性权力,
最终影响具体任务预测的准确性和稳健性。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation ( MCDA ) for brain disorder identification and fMRI analysis.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), the MCDA framework employs dynamic graph topology augmentation to continuously generate two complementary brain networks, integrating self-aware and cross-sample augmentation to model both subject-specific traits and functional variability across individuals.
Then, we propose a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme, which can capture not only the interrelationships between each augmented view and the original network but also the interrelationships between different augmented views.
A similarity-score gradient analysis characterizes the optimization directions of these constraints, and a boundedness analysis establishes a lower bound for the contrastive objective.
We evaluate the MCDA on two public rs-fMRI datasets (1,236 subjects), with experimental results validating that our MCDA surpasses several state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches in automated brain disorder identification.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了由地理学指导的多视图图对比性学习框架,并配有动态地理学地理学增殖(MCDA),用于脑功能障碍识别和fMRI分析.
如图1(a)所示,MCDA框架采用动态图形拓扑法,不断生成两个互补的大脑网络,将自我意识和跨样本拓扑相结合,以模型化特定主题的特征和不同个人的功能可变性。
然后,我们提出了一个地形学指导的多视图图对比学习计划,它不仅可以捕捉到每个增益视图与原始网络之间的相互关系,还可以捕捉到不同增益视图之间的相互关系.
类似分数梯度分析是这些制约的优化取向的特征,而极限分析则为对比性目标确定了下限.
我们在两个公共rs-fMRI数据集(1,236个课题)上评价MCDA,实验结果证实我们的MCDA在自动脑障碍识别中超过了几种最先进的方法.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed MCDA framework for rs-fMRI analysis. (a) The framework comprises brain network construction, dynamic graph augmentation, and topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning. (b) Self-aware augmentation provides subject-specific modulation, while cross-sample augmentation introduces spatial and temporal perturbations from other subjects. (c) The DAU module uses a shared BiGRU to summarize cross-epoch augmentation histories and sigmoid-gated fusion to refine current augmented views using branch-specific historical references.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized below: 1. We develop a dynamic augmentation update module that adaptively refines augmented brain networks through history-guided gated fusion. 2. The proposed dual-augmentation strategy combines subject-specific modulation with cross-sample spatial and temporal perturbations to generate complementary brain network views. 3. A topology-guided multi-view contrastive scheme balances consistency and diversity through constraints between original views and across augmented views. 4. We characterize the optimization directions of the contrastive constraints through similarity-score gradient analysis. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets of 1,236 subjects assess classification performance and explore model-derived brain region associations.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们开发一个动态增强更新模块,通过历史导门聚变对增强的大脑网络进行适应性的改进。 2. 拟议的双增强战略将特定主题的调制与跨样本空间和时间扰动相结合,以产生互补的大脑网络观点. 3. 由地形学指导的多观点对比办法通过原始观点与扩增观点之间的制约,平衡了一致性和多样性。 4. 我们通过相似性分数梯度分析来描述对比性制约的优化方向。 对1,236个学科的两个公共rs-fMRI数据集进行实验,评估分类性能并探索模型衍生出脑区域协会.

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. We briefly review the most relevant work in Section II . Section III interprets our proposed MCDA framework, while Section IV covers materials, experimental settings and experimental results. Section V examines key components, parameter sensitivity, brain region associations, and limitations of MCDA. Finally, this paper is concluded in Section VI .

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Graph Augmentation of FMRI-Derived Brain Networks
blocks.zh: II-A 图1 强化FMRI-已启用脑网

blocks.en:
Graph augmentation generates diverse brain network views to support robust representation learning from rs-fMRI data.
Existing techniques can largely be categorized as static epoch-based augmentation strategies.
Early representative methods [ 6 , 10 ] perform graph augmentation directly on the original BOLD time series using window slicing to generate diverse training samples while preserving temporal continuity.
More recently, deep generative models have been employed to produce diverse views that conform to the data distribution.
For instance, Wang et al. [ 11 ] integrated diffusion models with graph augmentation, simultaneously modifying both the topological structure and node features to enhance brain network representations.
Li et al. [ 12 ] perform graph augmentation via multi-view contrastive self-supervised learning, where a learner-instructor framework enforces consistency and enables self-updating to mine hidden topological connections from raw fMRI data.
blocks.zh:
图形增强生成不同的脑网络观点,支持从rs-fMRI数据中进行强势的表达学习.
现有技术基本上可以归类为以静态时代为基础的增强战略。
早期的代表性方法[6,10]直接在BOLD的原始时间序列上进行图增能,使用窗口切片来生成不同的训练样本,同时保持时间连续性.
最近,采用了深层基因模型,以得出符合数据分布的各种不同观点。
以王等为例. [11] 有图增益的集成传播模型,同时修改地貌结构和节点特征来增强脑网络表现.
李等编. [12] 通过多视图对比自导自导的学习来进行图增,其中学习者-导师框架执行一致性,并能够从原始的fMRI数据中自我更新到我所隐藏的地貌联系.

blocks.en: Augmentation strategies driven solely by current representations do not explicitly exploit the evolution of augmented views across training epochs. In contrast, MCDA summarizes recent augmentation histories using a shared BiGRU and adaptively fuses current views with historical references through sigmoid gating, enabling history-guided refinement beyond current-step view generation.
blocks.zh: 完全由现有表述推动的增强战略并没有明确地利用各个培训阶段扩大观点的演变。 相反地,MCDA利用共享的BiGRU总结了最近的增强历史,并适应性地将当前的观点与历史参考通过sigmoid gating相融合,使得历史指导的完善超越了目前阶段的视图生成。

blocks.en: II-B Graph Contrastive Learning for fMRI analysis
blocks.zh: II-B 用于fMRI分析的图表对比性学习

blocks.en:
Graph contrastive learning (GCL) analyzes relationships between augmented views to learn brain network representations for rs-fMRI-based brain disorder diagnosis.
By maximizing the agreement between differently augmented views of the same brain network, GCL encourages the model to capture invariant and robust functional patterns [ 13 ] .
Early works in this domain primarily utilized single-view settings, focusing on temporal or functional perturbations to project brain networks into a discriminative feature space [ 14 ] .
More recently, research has shifted toward multi-view contrastive learning to leverage diverse perspectives of brain connectivity.
For instance, Li et al. [ 12 ] developed a learner–instructor framework for unsupervised brain topology inference, using multi-view contrastive self-supervision to adaptively refine ROI interconnections.
Zong et al. [ 7 ] proposed an alternative multi-view approach that computes similarity metrics at both node and graph level perspectives between the original brain networks and their graph diffusion variants, enabling simultaneous capture of node and edge level features.
blocks.zh:
图形对比性学习(GCL)分析放大视图之间的关系,以学习基于rs-fMRI的脑障碍诊断的脑网络表现.
GCL通过最大限度地实现同一脑网络不同增强观点之间的一致,鼓励该模型捕捉变化无常而强健的功能模式[13].
这一领域的早期作品主要利用了单景设置,侧重于时间或功能扰动,将大脑网络投射为歧视特征空间[14].
最近,研究已转向多视角对比学习,以利用不同视角的大脑连接。
以李等为例. [12] 开发了一个学习者—指导者框架,用于无监督的大脑地貌推断,使用多视图对比自监督来适应性地完善ROI互联.
宗等论. [7] 提出了另一种多视图方法,在原脑网络及其图扩散变体之间,在节点和图级视角上计算出相似度度量,从而能够同时捕捉节点和边缘等特征.

blocks.en: These studies illustrate the value of multi-view inputs and multi-level representations in GCL. Nevertheless, constructing multiple views does not by itself specify how consistency and diversity should be balanced across augmented representations. Building on our preliminary multi-view formulation [ 9 ] , MCDA jointly regulates original to augmented and augmented to augmented relationships. Rather than uniformly maximizing agreement, it combines self-aware to original consistency with relative cross-sample to original and two augmented views diversity, encouraging complementary representations from the two augmentation branches.
blocks.zh: 这些研究表明了多观点投入和多层次代表在GCL中的价值. 然而,构建多种观点本身并不说明在扩大的表述方式中应如何平衡一致性和多样性。 根据我们初步的多观点的提法[9],《千年发展目标》共同规范原有的、扩大的和扩展的关系。 它将自我意识和原始一致性与相对的交叉抽样和两种扩大的观点多样性结合起来,而不是统一地使协议最大化,鼓励两个扩大分支的补充表述。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning framework with dynamic graph topology augmentation (MCDA) for rs-fMRI-based brain disorder analysis. The framework is composed of three key components: 1) brain network construction, 2) dynamic graph topology augmentation, and 3) topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning. An overview of the proposed MCDA framework is presented in Fig. 1 (a). More details are elaborated below.

blocks.en: III-B Dynamic Graph Topology Augmentation
blocks.zh: 三-B 动态地貌学增强

blocks.en: To fully leverage the topology structure of the brain network and optimize the propagation of discriminative information in augmented views, we propose a dynamic self-aware and cross-sample topology augmentation to generate two complementary augmentations of brain network for both individual-specific characteristics and inter-subject functional heterogeneity.

blocks.en: For cross-sample augmentation, two copies of original network 𝐆 \mathbf{G} are permuted from 𝐑 B × T × N \mathbf{R}^{B\times T\times N} to 𝐑 N × T × B \mathbf{R}^{N\times T\times B} and 𝐑 T × B × N \mathbf{R}^{T\times B\times N} , respectively. The same Z-pool operation is applied over the last two dimensions of each permuted tensor, enabling batch–temporal and batch–spatial interactions. The permutation changes the tensor layout, while spatial graph convolution is applied along the ROI axis using the corresponding subject’s adjacency matrix. Temporal convolution operates along the time axis. Each pooled representation is processed by the ST-GC encoder and multiplied element-wise by sigmoid output. The corresponding inverse permutation restores the branch outputs to the original 𝐑 B × T × N \mathbf{R}^{B\times T\times N} ordering, and their equal-weight average forms 𝐆 CA \mathbf{G}^{\text{CA}} . The resulting self-aware and cross-sample views are subsequently refined by the DAU module.

This produces a subject-specific sequence of pre-DAU augmented graphs G i , j r G_{i,j}^{r} for each branch r ∈ { SA , CA } r\in\{\mathrm{SA},\mathrm{CA}\} . learning scheme to jointly constrain the relationships among

augmented view.

The two augmentation branches are assigned different regularization roles.

blocks.en: The framework is implemented using PyTorch [ 19 ] on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. The local neighborhood size in Z-pool is set to | R | |R| =16, corresponding to a 4 × \times 4 region. The ST-GC encoders contain three layers. The maximum DAU history window length is set to K K =5, including the current epoch and up to four preceding epochs. The influence of the history window length is examined in Section V-E2 . Each branch-specific projection P r P_{r} is implemented as a single fully connected layer mapping the flattened augmented graph to a descriptor of dimension d d =128. The shared BiGRU contains three layers, with a hidden-state dimension of m m =64 per direction and an inter-layer dropout rate of 0.3. The terminal states from the highest layer are concatenated into a 128-dimensional vector. Each branch-specific decoder D r D_{r} is a single fully connected layer mapping this vector to TN gate logits, followed by the sigmoid and reshape operations defined in Eq. ( 7 ). Both fully connected layers include biases.

All trainable modules are initialized before constructing the Adam optimizer [ 20 ] . Training runs for 200 epochs with an initial learning rate of 0.001, which is multiplied by 0.5 every 50 epochs. The learning-rate scheduler is updated at the end of each epoch. The batch size is specified in Section V-E3 , and the loss weights are set to α = 0.3 \alpha=0.3 , β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 , and λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 .
During training, the original brain network and its self-aware and cross-sample augmented views are processed by the same classification branch. Their predicted patient probabilities are averaged according to Eq. (14), and the averaged probability is used to compute the classification loss.
At test time, we construct augmentation histories for each unseen subject using the last K K epoch-end checkpoints. Each checkpoint generates pre-DAU views and descriptors using its augmentation modules and projections. The chronologically ordered descriptors are processed by the final checkpoint’s DAU, using the preceding checkpoint’s pre-DAU views as references in Eq. (7). The final checkpoint’s classifier processes the original and two refined views, and their predicted probabilities are averaged according to Eq. (14). All checkpoints are frozen and used in evaluation mode. For clarity, we show the detailed training process of our proposed MCDA framework in Algorithm 1 .

所有可训练模块在构建亚当优化器[20]前被初始化. 培训面向200个学期,初始学习率为0.001,每50个学期增加0.5个。 学习率调度器在每个纪元末更新. 批量大小由V-E3节规定,损失重量被设定为:α=0.3\α=0.3,β=1.0\β=1.0,+=0.5\lambda=0.5.
训练期间,由同级分类分会处理原脑网络及其自觉和跨样本增强的视图. 其预测的患者概率按照Eq. (14)进行平均计算,并使用平均概率来计算分类损失.
在试验时,我们用K K时代末期的最后检查站,为每个未见对象构建增强历史。 每个检查站都使用其扩增模块和预测,生成DAU前视图和描述符. 按时间顺序排列的描述词由最后检查站的DAU处理,在Eq.(7)中参考前一个检查站的DAU观点。 最终检查站的分类员处理原始观点和两个精炼观点,其预测概率根据Eq.(14)进行平均计算。 所有检查站被冻结,并用于评价模式。 为了明确起见,我们用算法1来显示我们提议的军事和民防框架的详细培训过程。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed MCDA framework on two rs-fMRI datasets: 1) REST-meta-MDD Consortium (REST-MDD 1 1 1 http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD ) [ 21 ] and 2) Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE 2 2 2 http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide ) [ 22 ] .
For each dataset, we use the top three largest sites in the experiments. The demographic information of these subjects from REST-MDD and ABIDE is provided in Table I .
blocks.zh:
我们以两个rs-fMRI数据集评价拟议的MCDA框架: 1) REST-meta-MDD集团(REST-MDD 1 1 1 1 http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD ) [21]和2] 自闭症脑成像数据交换(ABIDE 2 2 2 http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide ) [22].
对于每个数据集,我们使用实验中最大的三个站点. 这些科目的人口统计资料见表一。

blocks.en: 1) REST-MDD. For the REST-MDD dataset, the three largest sites are selected for analysis: Site 20, Site 21, and Site 25, which respectively include 282 patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) and 251 healthy controls (HCs); 86 MDD patients and 70 HCs; and 89 MDD patients and 63 HCs, with acquisition details provided in the original dataset publication [ 21 ] . All rs-fMRI data from REST-MDD were preprocessed using the DPARSF pipeline [ 23 ] . The first 10 volumes were discarded, followed by standard preprocessing procedures including head motion correction, spatial smoothing, normalization, band-pass filtering ( 0.01–0.10,Hz ), nuisance signal regression, and spatial standardization.
blocks.zh: 1) REST-MDD. 对于REST-MDD数据集,选取了三个最大的站点进行分析:站点20,站点21和站点25,分别包括282名患有重大抑郁症(MDD)和251名健康控制(HC)的患者;86名MDD患者和70名HC;89名MDD患者和63名HC,获取细节见于原始数据集出版物 [21]. REST-MDD的所有rs-fMRI数据都是使用DPARSF管道进行预处理[23]. 前10卷被丢弃,然后是标准预处理程序,包括头部运动修正、空间平滑、正常化、带宽-通过过滤(0.01-0.10.Hz)、扰动信号回归和空间标准化。

blocks.en: 2) ABIDE. In ABIDE, we use three sites, including Site NYU with 79 ASD and 105 HC subjects, Site UM with 55 ASD and 55 HC subjects, and Site USM with 58 ASD and 43 HC subjects, with acquisition details provided in the original dataset publication [ 22 ] . The rs-fMRI data were preprocessed based on the DPARSF pipeline [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: (2) ABIDE。 在ABIDE中,我们使用三个站点,包括Site NYU(79个ASD和105个HC主题),Site UM(55个ASD和55个HC主题),以及Site USM(58个ASD和43个HC主题),在原始数据集出版物中提供了获取细节[22]. rs-fMRI数据是根据DPARSF管道进行预处理的 [23].

blocks.en: For both datasets, the brain was parcellated into 116 ROIs using the original Automated Anatomical Labeling (AAL) atlas [ 24 ] , and the mean BOLD time series was extracted from each ROI. The repetition time (TR) was 2000 ms at all six sites. For each subject, the final model input consisted of 200 time points from 116 ROIs, yielding 𝐆 ∈ 𝐑 200 × 116 \mathbf{G}\in\mathbf{R}^{200\times 116} .

blocks.en:
In our experiments, we perform five-fold cross-validation independently at each site using random subject-level splits. In each fold, one subset is held out for testing, while the remaining data are split into training and validation sets at an 80:20 ratio for model fitting and selection, respectively. All competing methods are retrained using identical data partitions. Model selection is based solely on validation performance. Results are reported as the mean and standard deviation across the five test folds.
The evaluation metrics include accuracy (ACC), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), precision (PRE), and recall (REC).
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们使用随机的主题平分,在每个站点独立进行5倍的交叉验证. 在每一叠中,有一个子集用于测试,而剩下的数据则被分为培训和验证集,分别以80:20的比例进行模型配置和选择. 所有相竞方法都使用相同的数据分区进行再训练. 模型选择完全基于验证性能. 报告的结果是五个测试折叠的平均值和标准差。
评价指标包括准确度(ACC)、接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUC)、精度(PRE)和召回(REC)。

blocks.en: We compare MCDA with the following six SOTA methods for fMRI analysis. Specifically, two methods (i.e., BrainGNN 3 3 3 https://github.com/xxlya/BrainGNN_Pytorch and LCAF 4 4 4 https://github.com/ku-milab/learnable-counter-condition-FC ) are advanced rs-fMRI analysis approaches, followed by augmentation-based approaches (i.e., TSDA 5 5 5 https://github.com/mxliu/ACTION-Software and GCDA) that enrich brain network representations. The remaining two methods (i.e., UCGL 6 6 6 https://github.com/mxliu/Unsupervised-Contrastive-Graph-Learning and MCS-GL) adopt graph contrastive learning from different views for classification.
blocks.zh: 我们比较MCDA与以下六种SOTA方法进行fMRI分析. 具体而言,两种方法(即:BrainGNN 3 3 3 https://github.com/xxlya/BrainGNN_Pytorch和LCAF 4 4 4 https://github.com/ku-milab/learnable-counces-econd-contellence-FC)是高级rs-fMRI分析方法,其次是基于增强的方法(即:TSDSA 5 5 5 https://github.com/mxliu/ACTION-Software和GCDA),这些方法丰富了脑网络的表述。 其余两种方法(即:UCGL 6 6 6 https://github.com/mxliu/Universided-Contrastive-Graph-Learning和MCS-GL)采用从不同观点中进行图表对比学习进行分类.

blocks.en: 1) BrainGNN [ 4 ] : This is a graph neural network designed for analyzing fMRI and detecting neurological biomarkers. With the brain network/graph as input, BrainGNN uses two node-level graph convolutional layers to learn the node representations, capturing topological and functional patterns from fMRI data.
blocks.zh: 1) BrainGNN(BrainGNN) [4]: 这是一个图神经网络,旨在分析fMRI并检测神经生物学标志. 以脑网络/图为输入,BrainGNN使用两个节点平面图分层来学习节点表达,从fMRI数据中捕捉出地形和功能规律.

blocks.en: 2) LCAF [ 25 ] : Kang et al. propose a unified FC-based framework integrating feature selection, feature extraction, and interpretation to reduce error propagation across stages. An adaptive attention network selects subject-specific, disease-related connections, while a functional network relational encoder models inter-network relationships to capture global topology without predefined edges.
blocks.zh: (2) LCAF [25]: Kang等提出一个统一的基于FC的框架,将特征选择、特征提取和解释结合起来,以减少跨阶段的错误传播。 适应性关注网络选择与主题相关的,与疾病相关的连接,而功能性网络关系编码器模型则在网络间建立关系,以捕捉全球地貌,而无需预先定义边缘.

blocks.en: 3) TSDA [ 10 ] : In our implementation, TSDA generates two augmented sequences by extracting the first and last 90% of each ROI’s mean BOLD time series. Subsequent processing follows the same pipeline as MCDA for brain disorder classification.
blocks.zh: 3) 技援处 [10]: 在我们的实施中,TSDA通过抽取每个ROI的平均BOLD时间序列的第一个和最后一个90%来产生两个增强序列. 随后的处理遵循与MCDA相同的管道进行大脑紊乱分类.

blocks.en: 4) GCDA [ 11 ] : GCDA combines graph diffusion augmentation with two shared-parameter graph isomorphism networks for contrastive pretraining, followed by supervised fine-tuning. We adapt this two-stage procedure to our five-fold protocol: pretraining uses the training subjects without labels, while fine-tuning uses the same subjects with their diagnostic labels.
blocks.zh: 4) GCDA [11]: GCDA将图扩散增强与两个共用参数的图异构性网络相配合,用于对比性预训,后有监督地微调. 我们把这个两阶段的程序适应我们的五重协议:预训使用没有标签的训练科目,而微调则使用带有诊断标签的相同科目.

blocks.en: 5) UCGL [ 6 ] : UCGL employs dual-stage fMRI augmentation and two parallel ST-GCNs for contrastive pretraining, followed by supervised fine-tuning. We replace the fixed 60%/20%/20% allocation with our fold-wise partitions, using the training subjects for both stages and their labels only during fine-tuning. For GCDA and UCGL methods, validation subjects are used only for model selection, and test subjects are reserved for final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 5) UCGL [6]: UCGL采用双相的fMRI扩能和两个平行的ST-GCN进行对比性预训,后有监督的微调. 我们将固定的60%/20%/20%的分配用我们的折叠分区取代,只在微调时使用两个阶段的培训科目及其标签。 对于GCDA和UCGL方法,验证主体只用于模型选择,测试主体保留用于最终评价.

blocks.en: 6) MCS-GL [ 8 ] : The MCS-GL framework enhances functional brain network-based diagnosis by expanding samples via Personalized PageRank (PPR) and incorporating local-global information as multi-view inputs for contrastive learning. During training, it extracts informative fMRI representations from unlabeled data to enable effective feature learning without supervision. In the final stage, model parameters are updated using a supervised cross-entropy loss.
blocks.zh: 6) MCS-GL [8]: MCS-GL框架通过个性化PageRank(PPR)扩展样本,将本地-全球信息作为对比性学习的多视图输入,从而加强了基于功能性大脑网络的诊断. 在培训期间,它从无标签的数据中提取了fMRI的介绍信息,以便能够在没有监督的情况下进行有效的特征学习。 在最后阶段,模型参数采用有监督的交叉垂直损失来更新.

blocks.en: IV-C Classification Results
blocks.zh: IV-C 分类结果

blocks.en: The quantitative results of MCDA and the six competing methods for MDD vs. HC classification on the REST-MDD dataset and ASD vs. HC classification on the ABIDE dataset are reported in Table II and Table III , respectively, under within-site five-fold cross-validation. We perform two-sided paired t t -tests on the ACC values of MCDA and each competing method obtained from the same five outer test folds ( n = 5 n=5 pairs; degrees of freedom = 4 =4 ). “*” denotes a nominal p < 0.05 p<0.05 for the difference in ACC between MCDA and the corresponding method. From these tables, we have the following observations.
blocks.zh: 表二和表三分别以现场内五倍的交叉验证方式报告了多氯二苯并二噁英和多氯二苯并呋喃与HC分类在REST-多氯二苯并呋喃数据集和ASD对ABID数据集的HC分类的定量结果和六种相竞方法。 我们对MCDA的ACC值以及从同五个外接测试折叠(n = 5 n = 5对;自由度= 4 = 4)获得的每一种相竞方法进行双相对t - t - 测试。 “*”表示对MCDA与相应方法之间的ACC差值的标称p < 0.05 p < 0.05。 从这些表格中我们得出以下意见。

blocks.en: First , compared to BrainGNN and LCAF, MCDA shows improved discriminative power. For instance, MCDA achieves ACC improvements of 6.7 and 6.6 percentage points over BrainGNN on Site 20 and Site 21 of REST-MDD, respectively. The possible reason is that topology-guided multi-view contrastive learning effectively aligns multiple views of brain connectivity by preserving topology semantics, enabling invariant and discriminative representation learning across views.
blocks.zh: 首先,和大脑相比 GNN和LCAF,MCDA显示歧视力量得到提高. 例如,MCDA在REST-MDD的20站点和21站点分别比BrainGNN提高了6.7和6.6个百分点。 可能的原因是地貌学指导多视角对比性学习通过保存地貌语义来有效协调对大脑连通性的多种观点,使得不同观点之间能够进行无常和有区别的表达式学习.

blocks.en: Second , compared with the two augmentation-based methods, TSDA and GCDA, MCDA achieves higher mean ACC and AUC at each evaluated site. On Site NYU of ABIDE, MCDA exceeds TSDA by 12.8 percentage points in ACC and 13.6 percentage points in AUC. The performance gap suggests that simple window-slicing augmentation may be insufficient to capture the complex functional patterns needed for ASD diagnosis. In contrast, MCDA’s dynamic topology augmentation maintains the brain’s complete structures, allowing its contrastive learning to capture both localized dysfunctions and global network characteristics.
blocks.zh: 第二,与基于扩增的两种方法(即TSDA和GCDA)相比,MCDA在每一个被评价的站点实现了较高的平均ACC和AUC. 在ABIDE的NYU站点上,MCDA在ACC中超过TSA12.8%,在ACC中超过13.6%. 性能差距表明,简单的窗口切换增强可能不足以捕捉到ASD诊断所需的复杂功能模式. 相比之下,MCDA的动态地貌增强维持了大脑的完整结构,使得其对比性学习能够同时捕捉局部功能障碍和全球网络特征.

blocks.en: Additionally , MCDA achieves higher mean ACC and AUC than the graph contrastive learning methods UCGL and MCS-GL at each evaluated site. Specifically, for MDD diagnosis on Site 25, MCDA exceeds UCGL by 10.1 percentage points in ACC and 15.8 percentage points in AUC. These results support the effectiveness of dynamic augmentation and topology-guided multi-view contrastive learning for within-site brain disorder classification.
blocks.zh: 此外,MCDA的平均值ACC和AUC高于每个评估地点的图表对比性学习方法UCGL和MCS-GL。 具体来说,在25站点的多发性疾病诊断中,多发性疾病诊断在ACC中超过UCGL10.1个百分点,在ACC中超过15.8个百分点。 这些结果支持了动态增强和地貌指导的多视图对比学习对于场内脑障碍分类的有效性.

blocks.zh: 四-D 读取研究

blocks.en:
To assess the contribution of key components in our MCDA framework, we compare it with three ablated variants, namely MCDA-I , MCDA-II , and MCDA-III . Specifically, MCDA-I removes the DAU module and directly uses the generated self-aware and cross-sample augmentation views without history-guided refinement.
In MCDA-II, to evaluate the impact of the contrastive loss ℒ SA,CA \mathcal{L}_{\text{SA,CA}} , we set the weighting parameter β \beta in Eq. ( 13 ) to 0.
Similarly, MCDA-III sets λ = 0 \lambda=0 in Eq. ( 15 ), while retaining both augmentation branches, the DAU module, and the classification loss computed from the averaged prediction probabilities of the three views.
The same three-view probability averaging is used during inference, isolating the contribution of the contrastive objective.
These variants are trained on the two datasets with the same experiment setting, with results reported in Table IV for MDD vs. HC classification and Table V for ASD vs. HC classification.
blocks.zh:
为了评估《多边疾病分类框架》中关键组成部分的贡献,我们把它与三个减速变体进行比较,即《多边疾病分类一》、《多边疾病分类二》和《多边疾病分类三》。 具体而言,MCDA-I移除了DAU模块并直接使用所生成的自觉和跨样本增强视图而无需由历史指导来进行精细化.
在MCDA-II中,为了评价对比性损失L SA,CA\mathcal{L}_{\text{SA,CA}}}的影响,我们在 Eq. (13) 中设置了权重参数β\β.
同样,MCDA-III在Eq. (15)中设定了 = 0\lambda=0,同时保留了两个增强分支,即DAU模块,以及从三种观点的平均预测概率计算出来的分类损失.
在推论中采用了相同的三视角概率平均值,孤立了对比目标的贡献.
这些变体在两个具有相同实验设置的数据集上进行了培训,结果在表四中的MDD对HC分类和表五中的ASD对HC分类中报告.

blocks.en: The complete MCDA model achieves the highest mean ACC and AUC in all six within-site evaluations. Its improvement over MCDA-I supports the contribution of the DAU module. The higher mean ACC and AUC compared with MCDA-II further support the benefit of including the ℒ SA,CA \mathcal{L}_{\text{SA,CA}} diversity constraint. Meanwhile, the comparison with the classification-only baseline MCDA-III indicates the additional value of multi-view contrastive regularization. Overall, these ablations support the contributions of the evaluated components to within-site classification performance.
blocks.zh: 完整的多指标类集评估模式在所有6个现场评价中实现了最高平均的行政协调会和联合评价组。 其相对于MCDA-I的改进支持DAU模块的贡献. 与MCDA-II相比,ACC和AUC的平均值较高,这进一步支持将L SA,CA\mathcal{L}_{\text{SA,CA}}-多样性限制包括在内的好处。 同时,与唯一分类基线MCDA-III的比较表明多视图对比正规化的额外价值。 总体而言,这些分解支持了被评价的构成部分对现场分类业绩的贡献。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: V-A Exploratory Analysis of Brain Region-Level Associations
blocks.zh: V-A 对大脑区域协会的探索性分析

blocks.en:
We analyze brain region-level associations in the self-aware and cross-sample augmentation features of held-out test subjects from Site 20 of REST-MDD and Site NYU of ABIDE separately. Features are extracted using frozen models trained and selected without the corresponding test subjects. For each subject and view, ROI temporal-by-channel features are centered over time, and linear centered kernel alignment (CKA) [ 26 ] is used to construct a 116 × \times 116 association matrix. For each ROI pair, the two view-specific scores form a two-dimensional response in a multivariate linear model adjusted for prespecified demographic and head-motion covariates. Diagnostic-group effects are evaluated using Pillai’s trace and Freedman–Lane residual permutations [ 27 ] . Covariate-only model residuals are permuted jointly across subjects for both views and added back to the fitted values before refitting, using identical permutations for all ROI pairs. Joint p p -values are corrected across the 6,670 unique ROI pairs within each site using the Benjamini–Yekutieli procedure [ 28 ] . Among ROI pairs with BY-adjusted p p -values below 0.05, up to ten pairs with the smallest joint p p -values are
visualized using BrainNet Viewer [ 29 ] ,
with line thickness representing Pillai’s trace. The MDD–HC and ASD–HC patterns are shown in Fig. 4 (a) and (b), respectively.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
To elucidate the process of two dynamic graph topology augmentations, we visualize the generated brain network augmentation.
Specifically, taking a dynamic self-aware augmented brain network of the first 30 ROIs from a subject in Site 20 of the REST-MDD as an example, along with the original graph at E=0, are visualized at a step interval of 20, with results presented in Fig. 5 (a).

为了阐明两个动态图形拓扑过程,我们可视化生成的脑网络拓扑.

同样,我们显示在图5(b)中,在具有同一主题的动态跨样本增强大脑网络中产生的11个图表。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 5 , the two augmented brain networks maintain strong structural consistency during the dynamic augmentation process. This demonstrates that the backward propagation in DAU module effectively constrains and adjusts the consistency of semantic representations, ensuring meaningful topological transformations while preserving critical functional connectivity patterns.
Meanwhile, from a topological structure perspective, the self-aware augmented networks maintain high similarity with the original networks. In contrast, the cross-sample augmented networks demonstrate more substantial modifications, particularly in the connections between ROIs located in the upper-right and lower-left regions.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,两个扩大的大脑网络在动态增强过程中保持了强大的结构一致性。 这表明,DAU模块中的后向传播有效制约并调整了语义表达的一致性,确保了有意义的地貌转变,同时保留了关键的功能连接模式.
同时,从地貌结构的角度来看,自觉增强的网络与原网络保持高度相似. 相比之下,跨样本扩大的网络显示出更实质性的改变,特别是在位于上偏右和下偏左区域的ROI之间的连接方面。

blocks.en: V-C Influence of Dynamic Augmentation Update Structure
blocks.zh: V-C 动态增强更新结构的影响

blocks.en:
To investigate the effect of different dynamic update structures on the performance of our MCDA framework, the proposed DAU module is replaced with GRU [ 33 ] and LSTM [ 34 ] , referred to as MCDA-GRU and MCDA-LSTM , respectively.
Specifically, the MCDA-GRU employs a standard 3-layer GRU architecture with forward propagation only, while the MCDA-LSTM utilizes a 3-layer LSTM structure, both maintaining consistent configurations with our DAU module to ensure fair comparison.
We conduct experiments on Site 20 of REST-MDD and report results in Fig. 6 . As can be seen from this figure, our MCDA framework consistently outperforms MCDA-GRU and MCDA-LSTM across most evaluation metrics, highlighting the effectiveness of the bidirectional dynamic update mechanism for promoting the propagation of discriminative information.
The ability to maintain semantic consistency in the topology augmentation during continuous updates plays a key role.
blocks.zh:

具体来说,MCDA-GRU采用了标准3层GRU架构,仅具有前向传播功能,而MCDA-LSTM则采用了3层LSTM架构,两者都与我们的DAU模块保持了一致的配置,以确保公平比较.

blocks.en: V-D Influence of Augmentation Encoder
blocks.zh: V-D 增强编码器的影响

blocks.en:
To evaluate the contribution of the ST-GC encoder in capturing spatial and temporal brain connectivity, we conduct ablation studies by replacing it with alternative modules.
Specifically, we substitute the ST-GC encoder with the Ra-GConv module [ 4 ] and a conventional 2D convolutional module [ 35 ] , resulting in three variants: MCDA-None (ST-GC encoder removed), MCDA-Ra-GConv (replaced with Ra-GConv), and MCDA-2DCNN (replaced with 2D CNN).
Ra-GConv leverage the topological and functional information of fMRI to learn different embedding weights in graph convolutional kernels conditioned on the ROI (geometrically distributed information of the brain), while 2D CNN operations process rs-fMRI data as regular grid-like inputs with sliding a fixed-size convolution kernel to extract localized patterns on the graph.
Consistent with the ST-GC encoder 3-layer structure, we implement both Ra-GConv and 2D-CNN variants with three layers each.
The results of MCDA and three variants on Site 20 of REST-MDD are reported in Table VI .
This table suggests that the MCDA-Ra-GConv and MCDA-2DCNN variants show decent yet limited effectiveness; however, MCDA-None yields significantly inferior cross-validation results, primarily due to its inability to effectively extract and utilize information from the augmented brain networks.
In contrast, our proposed ST-GC encoder outperforms all three variants by a clear margin. These results suggest that fully leveraging both temporal and spatial attributes of brain networks enables the extraction of more informative and diagnostically relevant features, thereby enhancing the performance of downstream classification tasks.
blocks.zh:
为了评价ST-GC编码器在捕捉时空脑连通性方面的贡献,我们通过用替代模块取而代之来进行衰减研究.
具体来说,我们用Ra-GConv模块[4]和一个常规的2D分解模块[35]来取而代之的ST-GC编码器,结果产生了三个变体:MCDA-None (ST-GC编码器被移除了),MCDA-Ra-GConv (被Ra-GConv所取代)和MCDA-2DCNN (被2D CNN所取代).
Ra-GConv利用fMRI的地貌和功能信息来学习以ROI(大脑的几何分布信息)为条件的图分化内核中不同的嵌入权重,而2D CNN操作处理rs-fMRI数据作为普通的网格等输入,并滑动一个固定大小的分化内核来提取图上本地化的图案.
与ST-GC编码器3层结构一致,我们同时实施Ra-GConv和2D-CNN两个变体,每个变体有3层.
表六汇报了REST-MDD第20站点的MCDA和三个变体的结果。
本表显示,MCDA-Ra-GConv和MCDA-2DCNN的变体显示,其有效性是正当的,但却是有限的;然而,MCDA-None的交叉验证结果却低得多,主要原因是它无法有效地取出和利用来自扩大的大脑网络的信息。
相比之下,我们提议的ST-GC编码器比这三种变体都差一分之多。 这些结果表明,充分利用大脑网络的时间和空间属性,可以提取更具有信息性和诊断相关性的特征,从而提高下游分类任务的绩效。

blocks.en:
To examine the effects of trade-off parameters in topology-guided multi-view contrastive loss ℒ TMC \mathcal{L}_{\text{TMC}} of Eq. ( 13 ), we adjust the values of α \alpha and β \beta . The parameter α \alpha , which regulates the contribution of self-aware and cross-sample augmentation, is varied from 0 to 1.
Meanwhile, β \beta , reflecting the impact of differences between augmented brain networks, is tested at 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10. Fig. 7 presents a subset of the accuracy and AUC results, which indicates that MCDA achieves optimal performance when α \alpha = 0.3, β \beta = 1.
Furthermore, we investigate how the TMC loss ℒ TMC \mathcal{L}_{\text{TMC}} , scaled by the trade-off parameter λ \lambda , affects the classification performance. The corresponding results on Site 20 are represented in Fig. 8 , and MCDA ultimately achieves its optimum at λ \lambda = 0.5. Using large values for λ \lambda , our framework cannot achieve good results. This implies that excessive weighting of the TMC loss causes the framework to overly focus on the relative distances between multiple augmented views, leading to a less compact feature embedding space and consequently impairing classification performance.

blocks.en: V-F Limitation and Future Work
blocks.zh: V-F 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Several limitation of current work need to be considered. On one hand , the brain network construction relies solely on rs-fMRI. In the future, we will integrate multi-modal data (e.g., diffusion tensor imaging [ 36 ] , demographic factors [ 37 ] and clinical scores [ 38 ] ) to explore complementary relationships between imaging and none-imaging patterns. On the other hand , our application scenario is limited to data collected from a single site, overlooking the potential heterogeneity caused by differences in acquisition machine parameters across multiple sites in real-world settings.
A possible solution is to employ domain adaption to reduce cross-domain distribution difference [ 39 ] , which will be one of our future work.
blocks.zh:
需要考虑目前工作的若干限制。 一方面,大脑网络的构建完全依赖于rs-fMRI. 未来,我们将整合多模式数据(例如:扩散的拉伸成像[36],人口因素[37]和临床分数[38])来探索成像与无成像模式之间的互补关系. 另一方面,我们的应用情景仅限于从一个单一的站点收集的数据,忽略了现实世界中多个站点在获取机参数上的差异所造成的潜在异质性.
一个可能的解决办法是利用域位调整来减少跨域分布差[39],这将是我们未来工作之一.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
This paper introduces a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning framework (MCDA) with dynamic topology augmentation for brain disorder diagnosis and analysis. In our design, two complementary brain networks are generated through a dynamic augmentation update (DAU) module, incorporating both self-aware and cross-sample strategies to capture subject-specific traits and functional heterogeneity across individuals. In addition, we develop a topology-aware multi-view contrastive learning paradigm that simultaneously models the interrelationships between the original graph and its augmented counterparts, as well as between the augmented views themselves. We further characterize the optimization directions of the contrastive constraints through similarity-score gradient analysis and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective.
Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets demonstrate improved classification performance compared with several state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh:
本文引入了由地貌学指导的多视图图对比学习框架(MCDA),并有动态地貌增强功能,用于大脑紊乱诊断和分析. 在我们的设计中,通过动态增强更新(DAU)模块生成两个互补的大脑网络,其中既包括自我意识,也包括跨样本策略来捕捉个体间特定对象的特质和功能异性. 此外,我们发展出一种地形学认识的多视角对比性学习范式,同时模拟原始图表与其扩大的对应物之间的相互关系,以及扩大的观点本身之间的相互关系。 我们通过相似性分数梯度分析,进一步描述对比性制约的优化方向,为对比性目标确定下限.
对两个公共rs-fMRI数据集的实验显示,与几种最先进的方法相比,分类性能有所改善.
